title: Your stack, wired to sell
summary: GTM Infrastructure's head (coherence pass 3): 104px, stacked, two lines, “Your stack, / wired to sell.”, the accent the noun “stack,” — no longer “The machine that carries your story.”, which shared GTM Intelligence's “The [noun] that [verb]” frame. Lede: “We set up the domains, the data and the routing under your own admin. No new software to license.” The Orchestration Rules sheet is cropped after rule 2 at every width above a phone (rule 1 on a phone).

reference.site: GoNimbly solutions head (founder's screenshot) on the approved interior header X
reference.borrowed: Headline, short lede, one quiet action at the right, the page's picture at full measure under the head.
reference.kelwin: The picture is the layer's own document, typeset as a page (kit .ac-sheet), labelled Specimen in its running head.

motion: entrance: the h1 writes itself in (kit §13), then the rule, lede and action; the plate rises and widens.
notes: Coherence pass 2: h1 “The machine / that carries / your story.” (each line holds a phone line at 390; “your message.” broke there). the sheet was held whole (a 2,282px head; 2,499px at 390) — it now runs off the plate's foot after rule 3 (the later rules and the folio are past the crop; the page edge is drawn on three sides). Title “Routing rules” → “Orchestration Rules” (D6: one document, one name). Round 9 fix: the lede no longer rewords the homepage's 'Data pipelines, orchestration, and CRM architecture…' line; the running head names the client as illustrative; the Days allowed column gives the page a measured object (Security review's 14 days is the ten working days rule 3 acts on); the section clips its own x-overflow on phones. Coherence pass (round 9): see summary.
